title: The sheaf tensor left unitor on pure sections
statement: Let D be a small category with topology K and a sheaf S of commutative rings. Use the existing tensor and pureTensor definitions of [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. For every S-module sheaf M, object X of D-op, scalar r in S(X), and x in M(X), the left unitor sends pureTensor(unit,M,X,r,x) to r times x. No nonzero-ring or nonempty-site assumption is required.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 03EL: module sheaf tensor, sheafification and unit coherence.

proof.text: The forgetful functor to module presheaves is the right adjoint of sheafification; give it the induced lax monoidal structure. Its lax unit is the identity by the right triangle identity of the adjunction, and its tensor map on a presheaf pure tensor is the defined pureTensor.

proof.text: Evaluate lax monoidal left-unitality at r tensor x. The presheaf left unitor acts by scalar multiplication. Substitution of the preceding unit and tensor-map formulas gives the asserted sheaf left-unitor formula.

lean.statement:
theorem pure_left_unitor (M : Modules S) (X : Dᵒᵖ)
    (r : S.obj.obj X) (x : M.val.obj X) :
    (λ_ M).hom.val.app X (pureTensor (𝟙_ _) M X r x) = r • x
